title: Mississippi River Overlook
specs: Mississippi River Overlook stands just over 43 feet tall with illuminated stainless steel railings
Offers views of Gateway Arch, Mississippi River, and St. Louis skyline
No alcohol, glass, fireworks, sparklers, snap pops, tents, ground stakes, grills, open flames, tailgating, or loitering in parking areas
Chairs, blankets, food, and smoking are prohibited on the overlook
Tripods allowed only in marked/designated areas
blurb: Visitors can enjoy the Mississippi River Overlook, a 43-foot tall ADA accessible tiered structure with illuminated stainless steel railings offering views of the Gateway Arch, Mississippi River, and St. Louis skyline. The park provides passive open green space ideal for play or picnics. The park is open daily from dawn to dusk with free admission.
extraNote: Limited parking; carpool and arrive early recommended; MetroLink to East Riverfront station suggested · Bags and coolers subject to search · No drones allowed
